notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2624: Both entire originals independently read. Ibn Abbas supplies the actual report that the identified verse was revealed concerning the named expedition participant, together with the actual sending in a sariyyah. The quoted verse and its source translation identify the object of this narrated revelation report; retain them within Ibn Abbas's account, without inventing a separate recitation event or treating this as the Prophet's own direct explanation. The surah/verse locator is context. The source's parenthetical participant names are material identity wording and remain transparently source-qualified rather than repaired into a canonical genealogy; Hindi and Urdu give different awkward joins.
notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2629: Both full originals independently read. Muadh supplies participation in unnamed expeditions, crowding the camp and blocking routes, followed by the actual herald commission and quoted conditional announcement. Keep the actual preceding events and the full own wording. Hindi's final announcement has a damaged missing-object/join; do not insert Urdu's explicit or-road formulation. Urdu's footnote locator remains context. The unnamed campaigns are not identified externally.
notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2630: Both entire originals independently read. The actual finite fragment that Muadh and the others went on an expedition with the Prophet is supplied and may remain under its own reporter. The subsequent narrator-told-a-similar-meaning-hadith pointer is apparatus and supplies no continuation. Do not borrow2629's camp/route/body into this short occurrence.
notes.deenhindi-abudawud:2635: Both full originals independently read. Isam reports the actual sending on an expedition and the supplied conditional instruction. Keep mosque-seeing OR hearing an adhan as printed, with the no-killing-anyone scope and the actual attribution. No unnamed campaign or further outcome is inferred.
